title: Hyderabad RWAs push mandatory rainwater harvesting in every building

slides.head: Hyderabad RWAs push mandatory rainwater harvesting in every building
What happened
slides.body: Groups from Malkajgiri, Alwal, Kukatpally, Tellapur and HITEC City took part in the 13th National Conference of RWAs, organised by CoRWA.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Water scarcity, and the chance of it worsening under El Nino conditions, was a key concern raised by Telangana RWAs.

slides.head: national RWA conference
slides.body: They also want 20% of civic performance grants spent on RWA-picked priorities.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Five Hyderabad groups, from Malkajgiri to Tellapur, joined the delegation.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: CoRWA says final resolutions will be taken to states for implementation. Ask: Who would check that rainwater pits in old buildings actually work?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Hyderabad RWAs push mandatory rainwater harvesting in every building

Hyderabad resident welfare associations called for mandatory rainwater harvesting, groundwater recharge and lake restoration at a national RWA conference in Ernakulam.

Why it matters: Water scarcity, and the chance of it worsening under El Nino conditions, was a key concern raised by Telangana RWAs.

Source: Times of India. Image: Times of India
